name: editor
one_liner: A free, browser-based 3D tool for designing buildings and interior spaces, then sharing the models — like a lightweight alternative to professional CAD software.
buyer: A small residential architecture or interior design studio that wants an easy way to visualize and tweak layouts with clients without buying expensive professional CAD licenses.
business_use_cases: An interior design studio uses it to quickly mock up room layouts with clients live on a call, letting them move walls and furniture in real time.
A real estate developer builds interactive 3D walkthroughs of unbuilt units for pre-sale marketing pages.
A short-term rental host designs and shares a 3D floor plan of their property for guests and cleaning staff, clarifying layout without a site visit.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid hosted tier with private project storage, team collaboration, and export to professional CAD formats for design studios.
Sell a 'client presentation package' service: take a studio's rough plans and turn them into a polished shareable 3D model.

steal_this: Build a niche template pack (e.g. pre-made small-apartment or tiny-home layouts) for the editor and sell it to DIY renovators as a $29 starter kit.
